title: Level ranks label consistency + per-level upgrade cost display and purchase UI

requirements.summary: Ensure the 5 Level rank labels are displayed consistently across the UI and legacy "Noob 🫠" is never shown.
acceptanceCriteria: Wherever the app displays the rank list (including any Ranks UI and Level UI), the ranks appear exactly as: Noob; Beginner 📈; Advanced Student 💪🏻; Pro Student 🔥; Sigma Student 🗿.
The Profile page level tile and any Level status UI no longer displays "Noob 🫠"; it displays "Noob" instead.
Any backend-provided Level stage display text uses "Noob" (not "Noob 🫠") for Level 1 Noob and for any other Level’s Noob stage.

file_operations.description: Add a single source of truth for the 5-rank list (exact strings and order) and a small normalization helper to map any legacy UI values (e.g., "Noob 🫠") to "Noob".
Update the Profile Level tile and any Level-related text rendered here to use the shared rank constants and normalization helper so "Noob 🫠" is never displayed (fallback/default should be "Noob").
Update the "Ranks" tab content to explicitly render the 5-rank list using the shared rank constants so the list appears exactly as required and remains consistent across the app.

requirements.summary: Display and execute Level upgrades using backend-provided nextStage.requiredCoins (per-level increasing cost) with immediate-next-stage purchase and English error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend `getCurrentAndNextLevelStage()` (or equivalent existing Level status method) returns `nextStage.requiredCoins` that matches: Level 1 upgrades = 50; Level 2 upgrades = 100; Level 3 upgrades = 150; ...; Level 50 upgrades = 2500 (for any paid upgrade within that Level).

Backend purchase/upgrade method enforces: Level 1 - Noob is free and cannot be “purchased”; only the immediate next stage can be purchased; the coin amount deducted equals the required cost for the next stage’s Level number; and max level remains Level 50 - Sigma Student 🗿.

Frontend displays the next upgrade cost using the backend-provided value and does not hard-code 50/100; upgrading at Level 2 correctly shows 100 coins, and upgrading at Level 3 correctly shows 150 coins.

Attempting to upgrade without enough coins fails with an English user-facing error (via existing error mapping/toast behavior), and the user’s coin balance and level status remain unchanged after the failed attempt.

file_operations.description: Add a Level status + upgrade panel that uses useGetCurrentAndNextLevelStage() and usePurchaseNextLevelStage() to show current stage, next stage, and nextStage.requiredCoins from the backend; disable the upgrade action when not allowed (e.g., max level reached or hasEnoughCoins=false), and on upgrade attempt show success/error toasts via existing behavior.

Extend error-string mapping for Level upgrade purchase failures (especially insufficient coins / not allowed upgrade messages) to ensure the user always sees a clear English error via the existing toast flow.
